source_snapshot.items: Test connections between BMC I2C-9, HMC-7 and M.2
source_snapshot.procedure: On BMC run broad `i2cdetect -y -q 8` and `i2ctransfer -y 8 w2@0x6a 0x00 0xd5 r6`; PID1114953.
source_snapshot.criteria: Collect evidence/photos and check logs; no HMC-7/slot/byte oracle.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; substitutes physical probing for a sideband transaction.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Invents M.2 handling and leaves the route, endpoint identity and six-byte semantics unresolved.

old_problem: HMC-7 meaning, BMC I2C-9-to-bus8/M.2 route,0x6a endpoint and0x00d5 six-byte semantics, immutable slot/device correlation, ownership and recovery are absent.
disposition_reason: The source requests a management-sideband read, not physical reseat. ED-02/03 require that the reply be bound to the exact M.2 slot/serial and decoded using the OEM protocol; PCIe enumeration or an arbitrary six-byte response cannot prove the HMC-7 sideband path.
decision_basis: Read XLSX row139, same-row AI fields and history2527; unique identity confirmed.
Preserved bus8,0x6a,0x00d5,r6 and BMC I2C-9/HMC-7/M.2 coverage.
Required immutable slot/BDF/serial mapping and sideband-content correlation.
Rejected blind scan, physical probe/reseat, storage write, register guess, retry and DUT action.

test_case.test_name: BMC I2C-9 through HMC-7 to M.2 sideband read
test_case.purpose: Verify the named management path reaches the exact installed M.2 sideband endpoint and returns a valid device-specific response without touching storage state.
required_package: PID1114953 definition of HMC-7 and bus8 route to the M.2 slot
Vendor0x00d5 non-mutating pointer semantics and six-byte decoder
test_case.test_command: Do not broad-scan. After route/protocol approval, capture BMC/HMC identities, exact M.2 mapping, owner and health; execute one `i2ctransfer -y 8 w2@0x6a 0x00 0xd5 r6`; decode six bytes, correlate them to the immutable device identity, check sideband/storage health and do not retry.
test_case.expected_result: Exactly six bytes match the signed device-specific oracle for the mapped M.2; the HMC-7 path and device identity correlate, and no BMC/HMC/sideband/storage error or availability change occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires authoritative route, immutable device identity, decoded expected fields and clean health. ACK/raw bytes, wrong slot/device/value/length, NACK/timeout/stuck bus or any storage/management regression fails.
safety_gate: Confirm0x00d5 is non-mutating for the exact endpoint.
Coordinate bus ownership; no broad scan or concurrent raw access.
Do not reseat, access data, write sideband registers or reset controllers.
One bounded read; preserve first failure and stop without retry.
expected_evidence: Timestamped exact transfer, raw/decoded bytes, status and latency
Pre/post sideband/storage/management health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: The approved query should be state-neutral. Preserve evidence and stop on anomaly; use only pre-approved BMC/HMC/sideband recovery and never alter storage data or reseat automatically.

source_conflict.reason: HMC-7 route, target identity and six-byte oracle are missing; prior reviews add unsourced physical handling.

blocked.reason: Purpose and candidate read are clear; OEM topology/decoder and identity binding are resolvable RPUC inputs.

pending.execution_status: ENGINEERING DECISION RETAINED; REQUIRES CONFIRMATION; NO DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.unlock_condition: Approve the exact route, endpoint/register oracle and controlled recovery, then revise the record.
